dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: You must be tired from conducting the training, Sergeant Major.

dialogues.speaker: Marushkin
dialogues.text: That was nothing compared to the work you fellas have to do. But you, Illuga, always remember that resting when necessary is just as much a soldier's duty.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I know that. You too, don't work yourself too hard either.
